scripts.format:backend: prettier --check backend/functions/src backend/tests frontend/src/services backend/firebase.json backend/firebase/firestore.indexes.json
scripts.check:backend: npm run build:backend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:backend && npm run format:backend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:backend && firebase --config backend/firebase.json emulators:exec --project demo-petconnect --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "npm run test:backend:run"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:backend && firebase --config backend/firebase.json emulators:start --project demo-petconnect --only auth,firestore,functions,storage
